authoring_axes: Blender XY plan, +Z height; export_yup=True produces glTF XZ plan, +Y height

fit.end_shape_policy: Beyond central halfspan: uniform scale and translation only; no longitudinal radius scaling.
fit.fairing: Two periodic Laplacian passes, weight .15; periodic Catmull-Rom sampled twice per original edge.
fit.mounting_flange: 1.18 x .58 m formed perimeter, 2 mm corner radius; source-derived inner rim and perforated face retained. Fits 1.2 x .6 m grid with 16 mm web and 2 mm reveals.

measured_profile.method: Maximum imported Blender Z in 12 mm fitted-plan cells; robust median by inner-face and rim radial regions.
measured_profile.simplification: Outer contact and middle crest at rim datum; measured median broad-face drop on inner ring. Raw underside and tunnel topology discarded.

shape_target_adjustment.reason: Retain the fitted source inner rim and perforated face, form the outer mounting flange to a shared cassette grid, and set the rim relief to 18 mm. These are authored manufacturing adjustments, not raw source dimensions.

hardware.type: closed flanged captive head, no shank or hidden bore

uv0: Top/bottom normalized planar XY overlap. Each return edge projects its bottom UV 2 mm toward the metal-side bank of the same atlas; top UV follows the exact edge. No zero-area wall UV triangles. Sloped rim remains planar-projected. Hardware uses local dominant-plane face projection.

intact.attachment_policy: Four flanged heads seated at Z=0 on intact flange; torn upper-right mount relocated along surviving top edge. Underside support interface Z=-0.002.
